what: SWARM TASK QUEUE — Every question decomposes into JSON task prompts. Each chipmunk picks one. Many small tasks, not few big ones.
rule: Maximum task complexity = 1 triad (3 concepts). If a task touches more than 3 concepts, DECOMPOSE into subtasks.

format.constraint: Which golden ring constraint this validates (hard/soft/null or none)
format.input: What the chipmunk needs to know before starting
format.output: What the chipmunk produces (a JSON file, a code change, a validation result)
format.depends_on: Task IDs this depends on (empty = ready to run now)
